3OGO.title: 1. The Jellyfish Glow Switch (PDB: 3OGO)
3OGO.story: GFP makes jellyfish glow bright green; when the Enhancer Key snaps into GFP's side pocket, its fluorescence becomes 4x brighter!
3OGO.what_students_see: A dramatic + / - salt bridge (Arg35 to Glu142) and a snug hydrophobic groove next to the glowing chromophore.

featured_contact.description: Key Arg35 (+) forms an electrostatic salt bridge with Lock Glu142 (-)

1MEL.title: 2. Egg-White Defense (PDB: 1MEL)
1MEL.story: Lysozyme protects bird eggs and human tears by breaking down bacterial cell walls; the partner key has a long finger loop that reaches right into the deep canyon.
1MEL.what_students_see: A deep purple concave canyon on Lysozyme filled by a protruding golden convex loop on the partner protein.

featured_contact.description: Key Loop Tyr103 reaches deep into the Lysozyme Asp52/Glu35 catalytic cleft

6EQE.title: 3. Recycling Plastic Bottles (PDB: 6EQE)
6EQE.key_name: PET Plastic Groove Partner Patch (Virtual / Subdomain)
6EQE.story: This harmless environmental enzyme eats single-use PET water bottles and turns them back into recyclable building blocks.
6EQE.what_students_see: Students slide the AlphaFold pLDDT filter and inspect the greasy hydrophobic cleft (Trp159, Ser160, Trp185) where plastic chains lock in.

featured_contact.description: Wobbly Trp185 aromatic clamp alongside catalytic Ser160 in the plastic-binding cleft

1A3N.title: 4. Carrying Oxygen in Blood (PDB: 1A3N)
1A3N.story: Red blood cells carry oxygen from our lungs to our muscles using four interlocking protein puzzle pieces (alpha1, alpha2, beta1, beta2).
1A3N.what_students_see: Self-complementary sticky patches and salt-bridge latches that hold the four oxygen-carrying subunits together.

featured_contact.description: Key Beta-Arg40 (+) latches onto Lock Alpha-Asp94 (-) across the subunit interface

AF-A0A0K8P6T7.title: AlphaFold Plastic-Recycling PETase (AF-A0A0K8P6T7)
AF-A0A0K8P6T7.story: AlphaFold predicted structure of PETase including the low-confidence N-terminal signal peptide tail that students can trim away using the pLDDT slider!
AF-A0A0K8P6T7.what_students_see: A floppy orange/red low-confidence N-terminal tail (pLDDT < 60) attached to a rock-solid dark-blue catalytic core (pLDDT > 90).

featured_contact.description: Hydrophobic plastic-binding clamp Trp185 and active Ser160

1BVK.title: Hen Egg-White Lysozyme + Antibody Fv (PDB: 1BVK)
1BVK.story: Classic AP/IB Biology egg-white lysozyme bound to a natural partner.
1BVK.what_students_see: Complementary surface hills and valleys locking together.

featured_contact.description: Interface contact between Lysozyme Asp101 and partner Tyr50

1FDL.title: Hen Egg-White Lysozyme + D1.3 Fab (PDB: 1FDL)
1FDL.story: Classic textbook lock-and-key complex of egg-white lysozyme.
1FDL.what_students_see: Tightly packed interface with zero atomic overlaps.

featured_contact.description: Hydrogen-bonding and shape lock at Lysozyme Gln121
